title: Hey Jude (coda)
hook: Why the *Hey Jude* ending could go on forever
cover_text: The *borrowed chord* that never lets it end

chords.name: Eb
chords.text: *E♭* isn't in F major. It's the Mixolydian ♭VII.

chords.name: Bb
chords.text: Down to *B♭*, the IV. No V anywhere.

chords.name: F
chords.text: ♭VII–IV–I never pulls hard, so it *just keeps looping*.
